name: web-mint-commerce-admin-dashboard-with-sales-charts-and-product-carousel
title: Mint E-Commerce Admin Overview
whatItIs: A cropped admin window on a mint geometric backdrop with a sidebar (an active mint Dashboard pill), an Overview header with search and date, four KPI cards with icons and trend arrows, a sales analytic area chart with income, expenses and balance, a sales target ring, a top-selling products carousel with sneaker photos and a current offers card with progress bars.
whatItMeans: Mint highlights on a neutral grey UI feel fresh, and soft product photos add life to a data-heavy page.
techniques: Mint as the accent for active states and charts
Area chart with a soft gradient fill
Product carousel with grey photo tiles
Trend arrows in green and red on KPI cards

vocabulary.definition: Concentric arcs comparing daily and monthly targets.
An arrow and percentage showing change.
A line chart with the area below filled.
